question_summary: Conflict between shop drawings per Spec 08 71 00 and the built field mockup for stair enclosure interior door hardware; requester asks which condition governs for the upcoming submittal.
referenced_documents: Shop Drawings – Stair Enclosure Door Hardware Set
Field Mockup – Stair Enclosure Door Hardware
deadline_text: A response within three days would be appreciated.
